$comment: Optical exceptions (docs/visual-system.md section 9). A 0.5 spacing step, a one or two pixel nudge, or an arbitrary value is accepted by `pnpm hygiene` only when it is listed here. Each entry is { "file": path from the repository root, "value": the class token exactly as written (with or without its variants), "reason": why the system cannot express it, "reviewer": who approved it }. A repeated exception is promoted into the system instead of listed again.
